ad_library.summary: 5 live Meta ads captured on 2026-11-21 from the Visionteknewenergy advertiser page (the page shows roughly 70 active results; the 5 most recent, all started Nov 12, 2026, are reproduced here). Four sell a home solar system with storage; one sells the FUTURE+ hybrid inverter. All five click to Instagram chat. The website was read live the same day. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.destination: Instagram chat (Chat with us / Send Message)
funnel.meaning: All five captured ads click to an Instagram chat, not to visiontek.solar. The enquiry never reaches the website, so the site cannot measure, retarget or attribute this spend.

findings: All five captured ads click to Instagram chat, not to visiontek.solar - the enquiry never reaches the website, so the site cannot measure or retarget this spend.

Four of the five ads sell a home solar system, but the website leads with inverter and battery products (RISE+, FUTURE+, VAULT+, PULSE+). A visitor who lands on the site after a home-solar ad finds no rooftop-system offer, price or subsidy figure.

No live ad mentions the PM Surya Ghar subsidy or any price, even though the website's own blogs (Nov 12 and Nov 19, 2026) discuss hybrid inverters and batteries - the strongest buying lever in this market is absent from the copy.
The website has no contact form, no phone number and no testimonials in the rendered content; WhatsApp is the only conversion path, which matches the ads but leaves no measurable web funnel.

The advertiser page shows roughly 70 active results, but the five captured here all started on the same day (Nov 12, 2026) with near-identical copy - the account is running volume, not tested variations.
next_steps: Point the home-solar ads at a website landing page that sells the rooftop system (not the inverter catalogue) with a Meta Pixel, so the click can be measured and retargeted.
Add the PM Surya Ghar subsidy figure and a starting price to at least one ad - competitors in Telangana lead with Rs.78,000 and this account does not mention subsidy at all.
Add a contact form and a phone number to the website so visitors who do not use WhatsApp still have a way to enquire.
Split the account into two campaigns - home solar systems and inverter/battery products - so each audience sees one message.

site_audit.scope_note: The website was read live on 2026-11-21 through a rendered-content fetch. PageSpeed and sitemap were not run.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
